name: Apple EarPods (USB-C)
shortDescription: Apple's wired EarPods with a USB-C connector and an in-line remote for volume, playback and calls.
description:
Wired earphones shaped to the geometry of the ear, with a USB-C connector for iPhone 15 and later, iPad and Mac models with USB-C. The built-in remote adjusts volume, controls music and video, and answers or ends calls.

Apple states they resist sweat and water.

items.label: iPhone
